primary_embedding: final hidden layer mean over non-special non-padding tokens, L2-normalized for external evaluation
neural_target: existing frozen ChineseEEG run-level residual neural targets
neural_loss: 1 - Pearson correlation between standardized model pairwise cosine distances and fixed run-level residual neural target
lambda_policy: strict portability: lambda=0.10 only; no alternative lambda after external outcomes
selection_policy: fixed epochs; no early stopping; no checkpoint selection; run-07 excluded; all three seeds reported
